question: **Direction: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is "Guage."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Guage"** is incorrectly spelt.
 
• The correct spelling is **"Gauge."**
 
• It means an instrument for measuring the amount of something. (किसी वस्‍तु की मात्रा मापने का उपकरण; पैमाना)
 
 
• **Example**: *Do you have a tyre **gauge**__ in your car?*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the​ correct answer is Option 3.​

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__

 
• **Terrifying: **to frighten somebody very much. ((किसी को) बहुत डरा देना, भयभीत कर देना)
 
• **Frosty: **very cold, with frost. (बहुत ठंडा, पाले वाला)
 
• **Effervescent: **(used about people and their behaviour) excited, enthusiastic and full of energy. ((जन समूह और उनका आचरण) उत्तेजनापूर्ण, उत्‍साहपूर्ण और ऊर्जान्वित)
